functional_scope: Actual browser→API→simulation→saved results in an isolated staging database and artifact directory, including 14/30-day modeled arrivals, severity stays, disruptions, supplies, exact replay reconstruction, matching response saving, and stale/missing-result states. No fabricated result responses.
live_scope: Read-only hosted Configuration/Summary/Analytics checks, legacy unavailable values and evidence labels, static asset hashes, running image commits, readiness and saved-record/volume preservation.
legacy_behavior: Existing saved results are retained. Measures that were not recorded remain unavailable until a new run; optional operations features stay disabled on unmodified legacy scenarios.
